figures.description_from_manuscript: Mean five-fold cross-validation R-squared from engine-specific ridge probes on log runtime
candidate_inputs: Saved source/result cells23,25,26 in the runtime-probe notebook
established_evidence_and_boundaries: The final PDF embedded raster has exactly the same RGB pixels as cell 26, output 0; see notebook_figure_pixel_comparison.json.

The diagnostic uses full protein/ligand representations (combined 1,536 dimensions), with physical/protein/ligand/combined/combined+physical feature sets. It is distinct from the projected 256-dimensional acquisition cache.

figures.description_from_manuscript: Online runtime prediction error and calibration diagnostics
established_evidence_and_boundaries: The source reads the highest available cumulative query log per method/fold, computes cumulative cost, excludes round 0, and excludes unavailable predictions. It does not read incremental checkpoint logs.
Saved cell 46 table reports 88,117 calibration records for each of five cost-aware policies, totaling 440,585.
The final PDF bottom raster exactly matches saved acquisition_runtime_signed_calibration.png.
Signed-error curves pool policies/folds into realized-cost quantile bins (30 requested, minimum 15 records), reporting within-bin median log1p(actual)-log1p(predicted).
